label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y al costado del mishkán el segundo, al lado de Tsafón, hizo veinte tablas,
spanish: Y al segundo costado del tabernáculo, al lado norte, hizo veinte tablas,
grammarChanges: Translated mishkán (H4908) to tabernáculo, since it is a common noun, not a proper name.
Translated Tsafón (H6828) to norte, since it is a common noun (direction), not a proper name.

Moved el segundo to precede costado (al segundo costado) so the ordinal attaches to the side, matching the Hebrew feminine ordinal's agreement with צלע, instead of trailing after tabernáculo where it read as a second tabernacle.
readerNote: Reordered 'segundo' to modify 'costado' (the side), per the Hebrew ordinal's agreement with צלע, not 'tabernáculo'.
